Files you can edit by hand. Run reload after editing: it checks the files,
prints what changed and applies it.

In ~/.config/lwe
  playlists/*.conf            one file per playlist: NAME, MODE, INTERVAL in seconds, UNIT, and
                              MEMBERS, the wallpaper ids in play order. Copy a file to make a
                              playlist, change NAME to rename it, delete the file to remove it. list
                              prints each wallpaper's id.
  app-condition.txt           apps that trigger the running-apps rule, one process name per line, up
                              to 15 characters
  pause-blacklist.txt         fullscreen apps that never cause a pause, one app id per line
  settings.conf               the schedule as SCHEDULE="07:30=ocean;20:00=calm" and
                              SCHEDULE_ENABLED=true, day first, using playlist file names
  wp/<id>.conf                one wallpaper's own values

In ~/.local/state/lwe
  panel/records/<id>.jsonl    a wallpaper's history, one event per line; read only

A hand edit is safe unless the panel saves the same file at that same moment.
